limitations: All 112 original tools retained; eight declared tools cover existing room/message and group scalar state. No network delivery claim.

chat_post enforces existing room membership. Many other source guards only check that actor User exists; chatmessage_list/edit/delete and group administration do not enforce the stated author/admin membership boundary.
chat_create does not materialize all uids participants; chat_invite/kick certify one uid only. No full room provisioning, notification/typing/watch behavior or bulk operations claimed.
topic_post creates Topic without initial Post; post_edit creates blank PostDiff and does not edit Post.content. These interfaces remain but are not certified as complete workflows.
Source move/owner/update-settings/moderation/vote semantics are not claimed beyond declared tools; search is literal substring, not a full forum parser.
